title: Code-exponent coordinate
statement: For every counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the register vector of $\sigma$ has value $\sigma.e$ at coordinate $4$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the value of the register vector
associated with $\sigma$ at coordinate $4$ is the code-bound exponent $e$ of $\sigma$.
